text_block_list.text:
One day after school, on a training rest day.
Having some business to attend to, I stopped by the library with <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, what a coincidence!
Yep, I'm working on homework. Since today's my day off, I figured I'd knock out everything that's due.
choice_data_list: That's impressive. Is there quite a lot of it?
That's impressive. Is there quite a lot of it?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "With the handouts, the workbooks, and the ones due next week... maybe about five?"

"Come to think of it, <chrname> was
assigned a pretty massive pile of homework too."
Practically speaking, balancing academics and training is a serious matter. I hope all the team members can manage it well...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
With a meeting like that, everyone can get on the same page and focus on training!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go call out
to Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... Why do we gotta gather up
just for some stupid homework...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Which order was this again?
Jowa Incident? Or was the Otenmon Gate first? Hmmmm??"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's see? Ah, was the Jōwa Incident first?
Hmm... I'm a bit unsure, so let's double-check
the textbook just in case. What page was it again—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............
...Are you guys talking about history?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! It's Japanese history, the Heian period!
It's a chronological ordering question, but
I just can't help feeling unsure about it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah... that worksheet's the one made by that teacher with the glasses, right? It's always got way too many sorting questions.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, ya just gotta catch the vibe.
That's the part where the Northern Fujiwara clan takes the top, but—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...So, even after Fujiwara no Mototsune took over,
he kept going on the offensive and totally beat down Sugawara no Michizane!
It was completely the Fujiwara era! ...That's pretty much how it goes."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...!
Then for this question, it's... B → A → C → D!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Espo-san! Thank you so much!
That was super easy to understand!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you, Senpai, I think I can aim for a high score on the next test! Having a smart and kind upperclassman is truly a blessing!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. You're so reliable, kind, and caring. I'm so happy to be on the same team as you, Espo-san, and to be studying together like this!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
~~~~~~~gh, shut up!!
It's not like thaaaat at aaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I already finished my assignment!
I got no business here anymore! I'm going home!!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Espo-san is so shy~"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Thanks to Espo-san,
I feel like history has become my strong suit♪
Just one last push, let's do our best!

Afterward—the study sessions became a regular team tradition.
Here's hoping we can keep this momentum going and stay fully in sync!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go call out
to Yan-ko-san!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~... Yeah, we've made quite a bit of progress!
Shall we take a short break?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Doing it together really makes things go faster!
A homework session might actually be a great idea♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you drawing, Marche?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! Is this drawing a bulldog?
So cute~! As expected of Maru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. Seriously cute~! As expected of Maru~!
Like, isn't this amazing? The way each dog breed is drawn differently!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right~ It's hard even in chibi style...
Dog, dog... Hmm, something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Is that... like a slime?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, this is...
supposed to be a running dog... ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahahahaha! Whuuut~~ so cute!
Is it derpy, or like, avant-garde art?!
Can I snap a pic? Can I? It'll totally go viral!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I totally get you, Yanko-san!
I love Love-chan's unique art style too—
it's super cute!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm happy you like it,
but I have mixed feelings~! I really want to draw
a dog that looks a bit more like a dog...!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "I think it's best to leave space between your ears! And have the tail sprout from near the top of your bottom..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
Keep ears triangular, maintain distance... l-like this?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...A monster with ears and a tail?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right～～～～～?!
Drawing has so much depth to it～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! But seriously, I totally love these
kinda goofy-cute mystery creature drawings!
...Hey, can I post this on Umastagram?
We meant to take just a short break, but ended up spending quite a lot of time drawing... Still, it seems everyone has gotten a little closer. Let's keep holding these study sessions!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go call out
to Desire-san!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Are you and Marche-san working on the Japanese literature assignment, Loves-san?
...How nostalgic. I read that story last year too."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All the dreams the protagonist has are romantic
and wonderful, but... that makes them a bit
elusive. It's quite difficult to interpret, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You're right. Besides, couldn't this story... be made even more dramatic?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: First, let's assume this dream is a prophetic vision of the saintess.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
On the first night, a sorrowful future seen by the saint...
Leaving behind her savior partner and beloved prince,
she foresaw her own life ending halfway through her quest!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I-I see...?! The character setting suddenly became so dramatic and easy to grasp...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is a future that must be averted at all costs.
The saintess declares in her dream: "Wait a hundred years.
I shall travel back a hundred years and change the future!!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! It was the miasma filling this land that ate away at the god's power and the Saint's very life!
But... the source of the miasma lay much further in the past.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Just how many years back would we have to go?!
—Gasp, no way, all the way to the Age of the Gods...?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is the fifth night.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No way...!
What on earth is going to happen...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Saint Legend, Night 10! The Demon Lord, who was the Prince in a past life! Meeting in a dream, the Saint soothes the Demon Lord's deep solitude, and joining hands, the two purify the miasma swamp—"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"A happy ending...!!
Amazing... I feel like I could draw a picture book based on this..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Written by Desire-san, illustrated by Maru-chan", right...?! I'm definitely going to buy it...!

Regardless of how much homework actually got done,
the study session was a huge success! Hopefully,
this gathering will continue to strengthen our bond in the future.
